subject: APOLONIA CAPITAL FINANCIAL SERVICES L.L.C. / CP-0001330 and public name variants
method: Public web and official-route checks only; no contact, login, anti-bot bypass or private-source access.

findings.claim: Century R publicly reports a Thailand–UAE strategic MoU with Apolonia Capital.
findings.safe_reading: Public announcement only; no closed financing, completed transaction or return was verified.
findings.direct_fetch_note: Normal HTTPS retrieval failed certificate validation in this environment; the announcement was located in public search results and is not treated as directly re-read primary evidence.

findings.claim: Odoo publicly names Apolonia Capital for Financial Consultation & Financial Analysis LLC as a customer reference and describes a customised CRM/operations implementation.
findings.safe_reading: Supports a vendor-recognised implementation, not investment performance, revenue or client satisfaction.

findings.claim: The Innovate Consultancy, Stratedge Solutions and Uplift Strategies pages show named project claims and generic project metadata.
findings.safe_reading: Company-controlled pages; no independent client outcome or mandate evidence found.

findings.claim: The current LedgerMail dashboard displayed zero groups, users, email exchange and active wallets, while a 2022 public release reported 750K users and 2M+ emails.
findings.safe_reading: Product status, dashboard scope or metric definitions need reconciliation; this is not evidence of fraud.

findings.claim: CMA warnings/violations routes and exact-substring OFAC/UN scans found no exact Apolonia, CP-0001330 or founder-name match in the reviewed public content.
findings.safe_reading: Not a regulatory or sanctions clearance; dynamic pages, aliases, related parties and untested lists remain outside scope.

findings.claim: No attributable customer-review profile, verified review volume, recurring complaint pattern or employee-review profile for the exact UAE entity surfaced.
findings.safe_reading: Absence of indexed reviews is not evidence of customer satisfaction or dissatisfaction; unrelated Glassdoor/Trustpilot namesakes were excluded.

aggregate_claims.claim: Homepage claims $40B+ government-related transactions, $15B+ capital raising, $13B+ M&A and $4B+ restructuring.
Team page claims 250+ successfully completed mandates.
Fundable profile claims $75B combined team transaction experience.
SuperReturn speaker bio attributes more than $20B of closed transactions to the founder’s career.

limitations: UAE local court records, private regulator files, sealed matters, non-indexed complaints and closed mandates were outside scope.
DFSA and ADGM registers were access-limited in this environment.
Exact-string sanctions scans do not cover aliases, transliterations or related parties.
A failed/blocked fetch is not evidence that the subject is absent or unlicensed.
